title: Add paginate helper to a results module
instruction: Add a function `paginate(items, page, page_size)` to `results.py`. It should return the correct slice of `items` for the given 1-based `page` number and `page_size`. If `page` is less than 1 or `page_size` is less than 1, raise `ValueError`. If `page` is beyond the last page, return an empty list.
